purpose: Blind minimal cross-backend electrostatic accuracy diagnostic after repairing the harmonic backend to preserve heterogeneous MACE-MDP point-permanent and MACE-POLAR Gaussian-induced source semantics.

reference.definition: Frozen gas-density QM/PCMSolver electrostatic polarization component on the inherited per-case SMD intrinsic cavity.

candidate.energy_ledger: MACE-POLAR zero-field vacuum energy plus the heterogeneous general-source finite-dielectric harmonic-ddPCM stationary polarization scalar; only the continuum component is compared here
candidate.permanent_source: unchanged MACE-MDP exterior point monopoles and dipoles
candidate.induced_source: MACE-POLAR field-induced increment in the checkpoint 1.5-A normalized Gaussian multipole basis
candidate.model_drive: complete phi-side ddPCM adjoint projected into the checkpoint-native 1.5/3.0-A eight-channel field

decision_rule.primary_metric: mean absolute error of the electrostatic polarization component in kcal/mol
additional_required_reports: checkpoint, continuum, source, runner, and asset hashes

claim_boundary: Passing establishes only a four-case fixed-geometry cross-backend electrostatic diagnostic for the exact candidate. It does not establish total solvation free energy, matched-backend decomposition, transferable chemical accuracy, force-domain admission, public E/F/H/V/M, or Tier V.
